subject: Preserve PC pinch abort over terminal movement pop
description: A PC pinch abort now cancels the matching terminal order-pop queued by nested PerformMotion before marking the entry-latched element Impossible. This mirrors RHElementActorPC::Execute overriding the nested motion result with RHMOTION_ABORTED, so the later TERMINATED DoNextOrder arm cannot overwrite the abort. linux3 Profile_001 Savegame_022 replay-012 matches exact EOF; both task-36 controls and the focused regression pass.
